text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"――My American dream. To challenge the 
world from Japan and seize victory."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"If it's a project led by me... I will 
make this dream a reality, without fail!"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"――I shall show it before your very eyes. 
The moment this nation erupts in victory."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, on a day off. Through my 
smartphone screen, Casino Drive was being 
interviewed by PJ.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She proudly declared her resolve toward 
her dream. Just as I straightened my 
posture, determined to push myself even 
harder――

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Hello, Trainer. Do you have a moment to 
spare?"
choice_data_list: Casino! That interview video was so cool!

Casino! That interview video looked so 
cool!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks! Actually, regarding that topic, I 
have a proposal to make."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"There's an upcoming racecourse 
inspection... Would you like to accompany 
our team if your schedule permits?"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"You take great care of me every day. I 
truly hope you'll take these insights back 
with you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, along with Casino Drive's team, we 
arrived at...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the USA! Today, we're heading 
over to the racetrack for an interview!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, let's get going then! We can take 
our time and enjoy the scenery along the 
way!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
"Shoot! Haha, guess victory is ours again 
today!"

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text:
"That was just the warm-up! Come on, 
everyone, time to close the gap from 
here!"
choice_data_list:
Look, they're playing basketball over 
there.

Look, they're playing basketball over 
there.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes, students from nearby, perhaps? 
They're really getting into it.

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
"――Curious about the match? I was just 
watching it myself."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, that's right. Things are really 
heating up, after all."

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe, those guys are my classmates. Since 
you're here, wanna take a closer look?"

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Tossing the coin... up it goes! Tails! 
Guess I'll cheer for the other team 
today!"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Heh, interesting. Do you always decide 
things with a coin?"

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, if I win, lucky me! I do it all the 
time to test my luck."

text_block_list.name: Young Girl's Friend
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, forget about that and help me 
study~! I don't understand tomorrow's 
homework at all!"

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe, only while! Well then, I'm heading 
over there!"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh. They really look like students 
having fun, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Casino Drive stared fixedly at the girls. 
Perhaps she was feeling sentimental after 
returning to her old stomping grounds.
choice_data_list:
Since we're here... want to join in too, 
Casino?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
That sounds nice too, but... I was 
actually thinking. Trainer, could I get 
your opinion?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
The dynamic between those girls just 
now... I might actually be able to apply 
that to team management back in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
The 'fortune-telling' in particular caught 
my eye. Could we somehow make use of that 
to help the team unwind?
choice_data_list:
(Whoa... She really is devoted to her 
work.)

(Whoa... She really is devoted to her 
work.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the lead on a major 
project. ...Judging by age alone, it 
wouldn't be out of place for her to be 
playing basketball out here with the rest.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san?
choice_data_list:
Don't you ever wish you had a normal 
student life?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: A normal…… one, you say?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: No, not in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I understand what you're trying to 
say. After all, had a rather unique 
background.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Flying between Japan, America, and all 
over the world…… I have devoted myself 
entirely to the dream I've held since 
childhood.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Getting this far was by no means 
straightforward. I've tasted despair so 
deep it felt as though all light had 
vanished.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: —Yet this is who I am.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
The bold, chaotic path I have tread so 
far. It cannot be replaced by anything 
else. That is precisely why――

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Everything about them is precious to me.
choice_data_list: That's a really cool way of looking at it.
That's a really cool way of looking at it.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Eh... Ah. As the leader of this team, it 
is only natural.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
My path is... one I will continue to forge 
myself. I will walk forward with pride and 
dignity.
